cue: A comparison passes when one side did almost nothing.
lesson: A check that two runs are the same also bounds how much each covered; otherwise an empty run matches a full one.
evidence: aip-6fb1's same.mjs compared only the states both runs reached: a report cut to 5 states was 'the same' as one of 1286 (rv-8bd0 round 3, a Major); it now fails beyond 10% reached by one run only.
